title: PHP2Shell: remote code execution in the PHP core
summary: Two memory-safety flaws in PHP itself (not a library) that can lead to remote code execution: CVE-2026-109618 (memory exhaustion during upload-progress unserialization leads to a use-after-free) and CVE-2026-109619 (use-after-free in the fatal-error backtrace path, combined with OPcache type confusion). Upstream fixed both on 2026-10-21.
notes: Branches listed in eol_branches have no upstream fix; only a vendor backport can make them safe. A plain version number cannot tell you whether a distribution backported the fix.
